issues.description: Script sends game coordinates and address data to Discord via GM_xmlhttpRequest. This is a third-party server and may expose user/game data.
issues.location: sendToDiscord function (not fully shown, but referenced in hotkeys/features and GM_xmlhttpRequest usage)
issues.recommendation: Limit data sent to Discord, inform users, and allow opt-out. Avoid sending sensitive or identifying information.

issues.description: Script sends latitude/longitude to nominatim.openstreetmap.org for reverse geocoding. While this is a public API, it may expose user/game location data.
issues.recommendation: Minimize data sent, inform users, and consider local geocoding if privacy is a concern.

issues.description: Script requests Notification API permission and sends notifications. This is a sensitive API and may be abused.
issues.recommendation: Use Notification API responsibly, ensure user consent, and avoid spam.

issues.description: Script grants GM_xmlhttpRequest, which is used for cross-origin requests. This is a high privilege and must be justified.
issues.recommendation: Ensure GM_xmlhttpRequest is only used for necessary, user-initiated actions.

issues.description: Script modifies Element.prototype.setAttribute to block sandbox attribute on iframes for certain platforms. This may weaken frame protection and expose to clickjacking.
issues.recommendation: Avoid weakening iframe sandboxing unless absolutely necessary.

details: Collects address data via reverse geocoding

script_name: CheatGuessr Universal | GeoGuessr | OpenGuessr | WorldGuessr | FreeGuessr
summary: This script transmits game coordinates and address data to third-party servers (Discord and OpenStreetMap Nominatim), which constitutes critical data exfiltration and privacy risks. It also requests Notification API permission and modifies iframe sandboxing, introducing additional medium and low risks. No code obfuscation or DOM XSS detected. Supply chain risk is low as no @require external libraries are used. Overall, the script is not safe for privacy-sensitive users.
